description: This code-behind file manages the exam result page in an online examination system. It retrieves user session data, interacts with a SQL database to update and fetch user exam statistics, and updates the UI with the retrieved information and answer details. It also provides navigation handlers for various buttons such as home, profile, leaderboard, and logout.

classes.name: OnlineExamSystem.ExamResult
classes.description: Code-behind class for the ExamResult.aspx page, handling page load operations, database interactions for updating user exam records, and navigation button events.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; retrieves session data, updates user exam info in the database, calculates average scores, and populates UI elements.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event to navigate to the dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event to navigate to the user profile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event to navigate to the leaderboard page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event to log out and navigate to the login page.
